title: Sante Barley Trilogy Run CDO Leg 3 Review: 32K in Mindanao
seo_title: Sante Barley Run CDO Leg 3 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 CDO Leg 3: September 20 at SM CDO Uptown. 32K, 21K, 10K, 5K from Runrio.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 at SM City CDO Uptown, this Runrio-produced Sante Barley series leg features the rare 32K distance.
verdict: The Sante Barley Trilogy Run CDO Leg 3 is notable for its 32K distance option — a rare three-quarter marathon that fills the gap between the half and full marathon. Produced by Runrio at SM City CDO Uptown, it also offers standard 21K, 10K, and 5K distances. The 32K is a genuine stepping-stone for marathon aspirants. September in CDO is relatively dry by Mindanao standards. A distinctive Runrio-produced series leg with an unusual distance option.

sections.heading: 32K: The Rare Distance
paragraphs: The 32K option is one of the rarest distances in Philippine racing — a genuine marathon-readiness test. [1] Runrio's production at SM City CDO Uptown ensures professional standards. The Sante Barley series provides competitive structure across multiple legs.
